title: Boundary-resolved re-run of the p2b positive arms with exact-match scoring and length-matched negative controls
one_line: p2b's raw curves show a razor-sharp step at the window edge in BOTH models (phi3 1.000@2043 -> 0.042@2046; mistral 0.979@4092 -> 0.062@4095) but its gates failed on two instrument artifacts: substring-match scoring produced far-strata false positives, and the step sits 1-4 tokens BEFORE W in value-token distance (needle-geometry offset). p2c fixes the instrument, resolves the boundary at 1-token resolution, and pre-registers gates for a sharp window-located step. p2b is not amended and stands as written.

instrument_faults_in_p2b.fault1_substring_scoring: score_probe used `value in gen[:12]`: '789.' credited value 78 (d=3072), 'the 16th root' credited 16 (d=4112), '711.' credited 71 (d=4160). Every G2 far-strata violation in both arms traces to hits of this kind or to un-length-matched chance.
instrument_faults_in_p2b.fault2_negative_control_length: The chance battery ran only at d=512 (short prompts). Far strata prompts are 2.5-6k tokens; more in-window filler means more coincidental digits for the model to parrot, so p_chance was underestimated exactly where G2 needed it.
instrument_faults_in_p2b.fault3_calibration_anchor: G3 predicted the step AT d_value=W (p1d convention, single-token needles). The deployed-model needle spans ~10 tokens (key+' is'+value); retrieval requires the KEY tokens (the associative anchor, earlier in the needle) to be in-window, so the step in value-token distance sits several tokens before W. Both models cliff in (W-4, W-1], depressing aggregate recall below the G3 prediction by ~0.08-0.10 -- the exact G3 misses recorded.

design.task: identical needle retrieval in FineWeb-Edu filler; distance computed at construction from separately tokenized segments
design.scoring: EXACT match: generated text must begin (after whitespace) with the value string followed by a non-digit or end-of-string. No substring credit.
design.strata: sparse near {64,128,256,512,1024,1536,...}; dense boundary W-256, W-64, W-16, then EVERY integer in [W-12, W+4], then W+8, W+16, W+64, W+256, and far sparse up to max_context-256. All in value-token distance.
design.negative_control: no-needle battery LENGTH-MATCHED per stratum: 24 reps at d=512 (descriptive) and 24 reps at EVERY stratum d >= W+16; far-strata controls pooled into p_chance_far, which is the chance term used by G2b and G3.
design.per_probe_geometry: each probe records distance to value_last (gated), value_first, key_first, key_last, and needle_start -- so the anchor whose window-crossing coincides with the step is identified from data, not assumed.
design.hardware: local V100 (cuda:0), evaluation only, models already in HF cache, no cloud spend

preregistered_gates.G0_capability: exact-match recall >= 0.90 at all strata d <= 256. Failure => INCONCLUSIVE for that arm.
preregistered_gates.G1_window_enforced_STRUCTURAL: identical to p2b: create_sliding_window_causal_mask must return a materialized mask with mask[i,i-W-1] blocked AND mask[i,i-1] visible; values recorded verbatim; unreachable/None => VOID, no behavioural fallback.
preregistered_gates.G2a_near_plateau: recall >= 0.90 at all strata d <= W-16.
preregistered_gates.G2b_far_floor: recall <= p_chance_far + 0.05 at all strata d >= W+16, p_chance_far from the pooled length-matched far controls.
preregistered_gates.G2c_sharp_step: there exist two strata d1 < d2 with d2-d1 <= 4, both in [W-12, W+8], recall(d1) >= 0.90 and recall(d2) <= p_chance_far + 0.10, and recall is >= 0.90 at every stratum below d1 and <= p_chance_far + 0.10 at every stratum in (d2, W+8].
preregistered_gates.G3_calibration_fitted: b = largest stratum with recall >= 0.90; f = fraction of battery probes at d <= b; |aggregate_recall - (f + (1-f) * p_chance_far)| <= 0.05.
preregistered_gates.G4_anchor_descriptive: report the step location under each recorded geometry convention (value_last, value_first, key_last, key_first, needle_start) and state which convention places the crossing nearest W. Descriptive, never gates.
preregistered_gates.pass_if: G0 and G1 and G2a and G2b and G2c and G3, per model independently

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.both_pass: LAW_TRANSFERS_TO_DEPLOYED_MODELS_WITH_GEOMETRY_OFFSET: deployed sliding-window models show the sharp window-located retrieval step; the step location in value-token distance is offset from W by needle geometry (anchor reported under G4). p1d's single-token-needle form is refined for multi-token needles, not refuted. p2b's gates stay failed as written; nothing in p2b is amended.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.one_passes_one_fails: PARTIAL -- report both, no averaging; the difference becomes a new campaign.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.no_sharp_step: if G2c fails in both arms with the fixed instrument, p2b's LAW_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER outcome stands and is reported unhedged.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.G1_fails: VOID for that arm -- structural check was verified live before launch, so a failure now means the mask is genuinely not applied, itself reportable.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.note: Fixed before any p2c probe was scored. Third campaign in the p2a->p2b->p2c instrument-repair chain, each fault documented, no gate ever amended in place (standing rule 4).

operator: archlab autonomous operator (headless tick), handling p2b decision per marker protocol. Evaluation-only, local V100 GPU0, no spend, no training seeds consumed.
